author: circle_spatial_observer
exposure: Same informed qualification observer; labels and old source-row hints known. No blind or expert-independent certification.
coordinate_convention: All coordinates are unrotated original-image pixels. Evidence rectangles and manually located section/path witnesses are approximate, with conservative size intervals. They are not segmentation masks or changed original object boxes.
measurement_method: Human-style visual trace inspection by the same AI on native decoded image crops. Length/width intervals cover visible boundary thickness, plausible section placement and local direction uncertainty. They are not exact pixel-extracted measurements, physical dimensions, confidence intervals, or fitted values. No automatic morphology recognition, text erasure, reconstruction or image enhancement was used.
scope: 48 canonical group-feature opportunities, mapped to all9 fixed loci and16 fixed joint scenarios. No object-pair scores, label agreement counts, T, p-value or candidate selection by cross-image resemblance.

canonical_variable_policy: Each group-feature is one variable reused in every referencing locus and scenario. f88_top_pale_spread is coded exactly once.
dependence_and_bound_notes: Unknown fine-interface strokes between the f88 brown and pale groups are not used for two independent confident positive codes.
G3 positives may supply G2-like structural evidence in a drawing, but no general logical independence of features is asserted.
Any future Cartesian binary completion is an algebraic relaxation. The measurement matrix does not assert sharp jointly realizable morphology bounds.
Free-terminal-connector ambiguity is retained as null, never as a negative or a retrospective expansion of G1.
Null means allowed[0,1] under the approved definition, not absence or unreviewed opportunity.

availability_only_counts.note: Coverage counts only; no label or pair agreement counted.
